summary: Runware's former Grant Program page (runware.ai/grant-program) now redirects to its Startup Program. The only free, no-deposit tier is Starter: up to $1,000 in Runware credits for bootstrapped and pre-seed companies with a working product. The award is not fixed: Runware scores each application on product, traction and how clearly inference fits, and awards credits in $100 steps up to $1,000. Starter credits do not expire and are usable across the platform (image, video, audio, 3D and LLM APIs, editing, serverless and compute) at standard pricing. The Growth and Scale tiers are deposit-matching, not free grants: deposit $25,000 to receive a $10,000 bonus, or deposit $50,000 to receive a $30,000 bonus; deposits and bonus credits are non-refundable and non-transferable. Every tier requires a company no later than Series A, a business email on the company's own domain, a live website, a real product or credible MVP with AI inference at its core, and a Runware account. Runware usually replies by email within a week. The program is equity-free. Earlier versions of this listing (verified 2026-09-30) described up to $30,000 in free API credits for 12 months; the current page no longer offers that, and it does not state when the terms changed.
claim_steps: Check eligibility: bootstrapped or pre-seed, no later than Series A, a live product or credible MVP where AI generation is core, a business email on your company's own domain, and a live website. Personal email addresses are declined.
Create a Runware account first; Runware says credits are awarded to that account if you are accepted.
Apply at https://runware.ai/startup-program and select Starter as your tier. Give detailed product, traction and expected-usage evidence: the award is scored in $100 steps up to $1,000.
Expect an email reply, usually within a week. Starter credits go straight onto your Runware account and do not expire.
Do not mistake Growth/Scale for free credits: they require a non-refundable prepaid deposit ($25,000 for a $10,000 bonus; $50,000 for a $30,000 bonus).
